features.description: Probe mod under claude -p --plugin-dir; record V10
acceptance_criteria: V10 row Confirmed or Refuted with transcript excerpt
If Refuted, Phases 3-4 marked dropped in design doc
features.notes: claude -p --plugin-dir probe: session.start ran ailang --version, tool.call fired for Bash, context line quoted back by the model, stderr empty. Container run not done (Phase 3 entry check). V10 updated.

acceptance_criteria: /ail-lens on a missing path replies 'not found'
relative path resolved against session cwd
features.notes: tools/claude-mods/ailang-lens (from bootstrap#11 + mtime refresh) and README; /ail-lens resolves relative paths via $.session.cwd() and replies '<path> not found'; scripts/check_claude_mods.sh (validate + tsc + plugin test, NOT RUN when switch off). validate ok, tsc ok, 4 tests pass.

features.description: AbovePrompt band + /inbox pane + toast over ailang messages; never model context
acceptance_criteria: band shows count and newest title for 2 unread
Ack runs messages ack <id> and drops the row
features.notes: tools/claude-mods/ailang-inbox: userConfig inboxes/pollSeconds; $.clock.every poll of messages list --unread --json per inbox; band (count + newest title + Open), /inbox pane (Read/Hide shows payload, Ack runs messages ack), toast once per new id, first backlog not toasted; /inbox reply is a count only (C3, asserted in test). Engine rule found: a function receiving $ must be top-level. 5 tests pass on terminal+desktop.

features.description: Status line from newest unfinished sprint JSON
acceptance_criteria: fixture sprint JSON renders 'sprint M-X n/m · next'
features.notes: tools/claude-mods/sprint-status: newest (by FsEntry.mtimeMs) of the 10 most recent .ailang/state/sprints/*.json with status in_progress -> 'sprint M-X n/m · NEXT'; refresh at session.start and turn.complete, throttled 30s; cleared outside an AILANG checkout. 173 sprint files with 15 distinct status spellings, so only exact 'in_progress' counts. 1 test passes.

features.description: ailang check after .ail Edit/Write; diagnostics in result context
features.notes: tools/claude-mods/ailang-check-on-edit: after a successful .ail Edit/Write, ailang check --json from the project root; failure -> 'ailang check <rel>: ✗ N errors' + up to 5 'line:col cause' lines in the result's context (model-only); pass -> nothing; formatOnEdit (default false) runs fmt --write first. 4 tests pass. Live headless: claude -p wrote a broken module and quoted back '3:8 cannot unify type constructors: int vs string' without running any command.

features.description: Port of pi unowned-dirty with verbatim core; toast + context, never blocks
acceptance_criteria: silent when all dirty files are own
features.notes: tools/claude-mods/unowned-dirty: hooks/core.ts = verbatim pi pure functions; own files in $.state (survives reloads, unlike pi's branch scan); before a sweeping git op reads git status, warns via toast and appends to the result context; never blocks. Own paths made repo-relative (git rev-parse --show-toplevel) before comparing: pi's extension compares absolute own paths to relative porcelain paths, so it flags every dirty file including its own (pi bug, reported separately, not fixed here). 3 tests passed before a contract-only fix; validate + tsc ok after. check script now uses laid type folders (claude-code-tools) so tool args type.

features.description: Port of pi prepush-gate with verbatim core; deny on failure
features.notes: tools/claude-mods/prepush-gate: core.ts generated from pi (GateStep gateSteps goRoots makeTargetDefined skipRequested isPushCommand); same chain and refusals; hatch via $.env (launch env), typed-in hatch does not open it; status line while gates run. validate + tsc ok; 6 tests pass (a plugin's deny reaches the test as { deny }, not isError).
